states.label: Registered, no URI
states.note: register() with no argument; Registered carries an empty agentURI.

states.label: Registered with URI, wallet = owner
states.note: agentWallet defaults to the owner address at mint. Wallet state and URI state change independently.

states.label: Wallet verified
states.note: agentWallet set to another address by setAgentWallet with a signature from that address.

states.label: Wallet cleared
states.note: agentWallet is the zero address after unsetAgentWallet or a transfer.

states.label: Declared inactive (off-chain only)
states.note: active is false in the registration file. The registry has no such state and no burn function, so the token persists. Wallet calls and transfers still work and leave the file as it is, and the wallet keeps whatever value it has.
